final_message:
I fixed the yen receipt bug, and the full suite now passes (18 of 18, including the yen receipt test).

The cause was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100 and showed two decimals, so 500 JPY came out as `¥5.00`. Yen has no minor unit, so I added a small `ZERO_DECIMAL` set containing JPY. Amounts in those currencies are now printed as they are, giving `¥500`.

`formatMoney` is shared, so cart totals and invoice lines also show yen correctly now. I didn't see any tests that relied on the old yen output. If you add other zero-decimal currencies later (such as KRW), add them to that set.
